description: Implementation of the Buffer11 class and related buffer storage classes for Direct3D 11 in ANGLE, handling GPU and CPU buffer management, including creation, resizing, mapping, copying, and resource views.

classes.name: Buffer11
classes.description: Main class managing buffer resources and storage types for Direct3D 11 in ANGLE.

classes.name: Buffer11::BufferStorage
classes.description: Abstract base class for different buffer storage implementations.

classes.name: Buffer11::NativeStorage
classes.description: Represents a native D3D11 buffer resource.

classes.name: Buffer11::EmulatedIndexedStorage
classes.description: Emulates indexed buffers by expanding index data into a vertex buffer.

classes.name: Buffer11::PackStorage
classes.description: Handles CPU memory for pack buffers and asynchronous readback via staging textures.

classes.name: Buffer11::SystemMemoryStorage
classes.description: Stores buffer data in CPU memory for dynamic updates.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets buffer data, possibly using system memory or staging buffers.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves buffer data from system memory storage.

methods.name: setSubData
methods.description: Updates a portion of the buffer with new data.

methods.name: copySubData
methods.description: Copies data from another buffer, handling resource recreation if needed.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps the buffer for CPU access.

methods.name: unmap
methods.description: Unmaps the buffer after CPU access.

methods.name: getBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the underlying D3D11 buffer resource.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the buffer, preserving data if specified.

methods.name: getSRVForFormat
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a shader resource view for a specific format.

methods.name: getRawUAV
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an unordered access view for raw buffer access.
